_note: MuseStudio's stage (placeholders: replace freely). character.card: relative to the MuseStudio folder (or absolute; the plugin's config 'Character card' wins when set). location: a key of locations.json. spots: where the characters stand per location [x, y, z, yaw] (none: the map's origin). advance: auto false = click / Enter / Space for the next block; auto true = characters x per_char + base (the voice is off). monologue: a monologue package's block shows min_seconds + characters x per_char, at most max_seconds, then the next (by itself). relationship.stages: [affection from, the original's relation stage of her touch reactions (0 first met, 1 friends, 2 girlfriend)] - the app's own provisional marks for Muse's affection (Muse writes from its numbers, not these); before Muse sends one, touch.json talk.stage. touch.pose_max_seconds: a touch's reaction pose plays out (the original's talk waits for its voice), at most this. grope: outside a play, holding or rubbing one of these areas starts this play (the standing aibu) where she is (play_started source touch). blush: her cheeks (the original's 頬赤) by her arousal - from, to max at 1.0, rising / falling in seconds; the expression's cheek wins when larger. look: her face to the user outside a play while they are together (src/Look.cs, the original's free roam) - from this relation stage (min_stage, the stages above; 1 friends), within max_distance metres of her head. talk_climax: a block's anim climax in the talk (Muse's request of 2026-11-05; the user's decision: the standing caress's climax motion whatever she was doing) - play's female motion, its states in order (once: played through, at most once_max_seconds; a number: seconds), blend_seconds between them, the face preset (none when the block has its own emotion), then her scene again.
